  SELECT CustomerID, SUM(Consumption) AS total
  FROM yearmonth
  WHERE Date LIKE '2013%'
  GROUP BY CustomerID
),
c AS (
  SELECT cust.CustomerID, cust.Segment, y.total
  FROM customers cust JOIN y ON cust.CustomerID = y.CustomerID
  WHERE cust.Currency = 'CZK'
),

  SELECT Segment, MIN(total) AS mn FROM c GROUP BY Segment
)

WITH y AS (
  SELECT CustomerID, SUM(Consumption) AS total
  FROM yearmonth
  WHERE Date LIKE '2013%'
  GROUP BY CustomerID
),
c AS (
  SELECT cust.CustomerID, cust.Segment, y.total
  FROM customers cust JOIN y ON cust.CustomerID = y.CustomerID
  WHERE cust.Currency = 'CZK'
),
seg_min AS (
  SELECT Segment, MIN(total) AS mn FROM c GROUP BY Segment
),
least AS (
  SELECT c.Segment, c.total
  FROM c JOIN seg_min ON c.Segment = seg_min.Segment AND c.total = seg_min.mn
),
seg_avg AS (
  SELECT Segment, AVG(total) AS avg_low FROM least GROUP BY Segment
)
SELECT
  ROUND((SELECT avg_low FROM seg_avg WHERE Segment='SME') - (SELECT avg_low FROM seg_avg WHERE Segment='LAM'), 2) AS SME_minus_LAM,
  ROUND((SELECT avg_low FROM seg_avg WHERE Segment='LAM') - (SELECT avg_low FROM seg_avg WHERE Segment='KAM'), 2) AS LAM_minus_KAM,
  ROUND((SELECT avg_low FROM seg_avg WHERE Segment='KAM') - (SELECT avg_low FROM seg_avg WHERE Segment='SME'), 2) AS KAM_minus_SME
